messages:
Maya Patel: quick day-0 sync for Merchant PoV kickoff. goal: align success criteria, infra needs, and security asks before Monday's kickoff.
Ethan Liu: good plan. i'd cover: stakeholder list + access, eval dataset & prompts, staging provisioning, and pricing/po terms.
Sofia Ramos: adding SSO/SCIM and any vendor KMS/BYOK requirements. Legal flagged auth model earlier.
Ben Carter: buyer asked if we can run a 3-week PoV instead of a 1-month commit and requested a token cap with a short-term discount.
Maya Patel: we can support a time-bounded hosted pilot with a token cap. SE and finance need to agree on the $/token and concurrency limits.
Ethan Liu: ops note: if they want IP allowlisting for staging, ask for CIDR blocks. we can create a staging subnet and an API key scoped to the pilot.
Sofia Ramos: security-bot, what's the current status of their questionnaire?
security-bot: auto: merchant_pov_sq_2026.pdf uploaded to https://redwood.internal/sec/merchant_pov. outstanding: data_retention_policy, encryption_key_ownership, admin_access_review.
Maya Patel: Sofia, please pick up data_retention and key ownership follow-ups with their security lead.
Sofia Ramos: will do. also need to confirm whether they require HSM-backed keys or are ok with cloud KMS.
Ben Carter: finance: i can produce a short PO addendum with token cap + discount + models allowed. need target discount %.
Ethan Liu: recommend we offer 20% off hosted over the 3-week window, but lock model list to one production-calibrated model (rw-stable-1).
Maya Patel: sounds fair. success criteria proposal: 1) integration end-to-end with SSO in staging, 2) eval: F1 >= 0.8 on their labeled set, 3) perf: 95th pct latency < 250ms for short prompts, 4) throughput >= 40 req/s sustained during peak test. objections?
Ethan Liu: add a reliability criterion: zero production-impacting errors during the evaluation window.
Sofia Ramos: add a data handling checkpoint: no raw customer PII persisted beyond session unless explicitly allowed.
Ben Carter: buyer also wants an eval harness they can run locally. we should share the PoV eval template and a minimal smoke test.
Maya Patel: sharing example now: https://redwood.ai/pov-templates
Maya Patel: smoke test cURL: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model":"rw-stable-1","input":"Extract order id from: \"Order: 78910\""}'
```
Ethan Liu: provisioning note: I'll create a staging API key scoped to the pilot and put it in a secured email to merchant-pov@vendormail by 1728800045. need their CIDR to finish allowlist.
Sofia Ramos: also confirm whether SCIM provisioning is needed for their test users.
Maya Patel: timeline: they proposed kickoff Monday 10am PT, 3-week window after that. do we have SE coverage?
Ethan Liu: SEs available M-F. runtime oncall will watch the canary pool.
Ben Carter: will draft the addendum by EOD tomorrow with token cap, discount, and concurrency limits.
Sofia Ramos: i'll message their security lead and update the questionnaire by tomorrow afternoon.
Maya Patel: action items recap: 1) Ben - draft PO addendum; 2) Sofia - confirm SSO/KMS/HSM and update questionnaire; 3) Ethan - provision staging creds & request CIDR; 4) Maya - send kickoff invite + share eval template.
Ethan Liu: quick ask: everyone drop two representative prompt examples (classification, extraction, open-response) before EOD so i can seed the harness.
Maya Patel: thanks — will follow up after kickoff. :thumbsup:
note: day-0 PoV kickoff coordination thread. no title as per agents.md
